text: SUPERVISOR: the user gave the word on the PLATMOD implementation plan you offered after V28-V30. Plan only — no implementation. This is a doc draft, so it does not violate your REQBOARD commit gate (still the user's panel look). Post when the doc is on disk; I review, the user rules, then slice 1 goes to a dedicated lane.
